## Checklist

### Listing changes

- [ ] The source, working implementation, documentation, and license are public.
- [ ] The link is canonical and points directly to the relevant skill or collection when it lives in a monorepo.
- [ ] The type and platform claims are supported by upstream documentation.
- [ ] The description is one concise, factual, neutral, and non-volatile sentence.
- [ ] I searched for duplicate listings, issues, and pull requests.
- [ ] This pull request covers one upstream project or one tightly related collection.
- [ ] I updated both `README.md` and `README_ZH.md` with identical names, URLs, types, and platforms.
- [ ] The entry is alphabetized within its subsection.
- [ ] This listing pull request changes only `README.md` and `README_ZH.md`.
- [ ] I did not add `SKILL.md`, scripts, copied skill folders, assets, or platform indexes.
- [ ] I linked a prior issue if this introduces a new top-level category or type, or marked it `N/A` above.
- [ ] I disclosed my affiliation or commercial relationship above.

### All pull requests

- [ ] The changes are focused and the documentation renders correctly.
- [ ] Every commit in this pull request displays **Verified** on GitHub.
